GET /api/catalog.description: Returns full step catalog from step-catalog.json enriched with paramEnums and requires from step-enums.json. Response: { steps: CatalogStep[] }

GET /api/features.description: Returns FeatureSummary[] for all .feature files under src/features/ using walkFeatures + parseFeatureSummary. Includes app/flow fields derived from directory structure.

POST /api/features.description: Writes a .feature file to src/features/{app}/{flow}/{slug}.feature. filePath is relative to FEATURES_DIR. safeFeaturePath() prevents path traversal (Guard T-04-01). Body: { content: string, filePath: string }

PUT /api/enums.description: Upserts paramEnum values for a step expression in step-enums.json. Used by StepDetailModal inline enum editor. Body: { expression: string, paramEnums: ParamEnumDef[] }

POST /api/import.description: Accepts .txt file via FormData, writes to os.tmpdir() with generated name (T-04-06), runs import-scenarios.ts via execSync with 30s timeout, returns { ok, featureContent, featurePath, newCount, skipCount }. Max 1MB. Windows-safe via shell:cmd.exe.

POST /api/github/push.description: Creates or updates a .feature file on GitHub via REST API v3. Token passed via x-github-token header (never in body — T-05-03-03). filePath validated with whitelist regex + path traversal block (T-05-03-01). Token scrubbed from error messages (T-05-03-02).

POST /api/jira/sync.description: Scans all .feature files for @ticket:PROJ-123 tags and posts the scenario text as an ADF code block comment on the Jira issue. Token via x-jira-token header. SSRF guard blocks RFC-1918 addresses (T-05-jira-01). Returns { synced, skipped, errors }.

GET /api/download.description: Returns raw content of a .feature file given a path relative to FEATURES_DIR. Used by features page 'Edit' button to load a feature into the editor via localStorage.
